Daily Excelsior 04:29 AM Sep 24, 2026 IST PATNA, Sep 23 : The Bihar Cabinet on Wednesday approved the establishment of Mata Sita University in Patna and Rashtra Kavi Ramdhari Singh Dinkar University in Begusarai. The decisions were taken at a Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary. Additional Cabinet Secretary Arvind Kumar Choudhary told news persons after the meeting that the Cabinet approved Rs 15 crore each for the establishment of the two universities to meet expenditure on salaries and other establishment-related requirements. Advertisement The proposed university in Patna was initially referred to as Maa Sita University, but the Cabinet approved an amendment changing the name to Mata Sita University. The cabinet also cleared a slew of proposals involving police modernisation, dairy and fisheries development, power sector liabilities and prison reforms. Among the major decisions, the Cabinet sanctioned Rs 24.50 crore for procurement of 50 drones under the centrally sponsored scheme for assistance to states and union Territories for police modernisation. The drones are intended for crowd-control and management, riverine and anti-Naxal operations, disaster management and other policing requirements, 8nforned Choudhary. An additional Rs 33.685 crore was approved for procurement of equipment and other items for district police, railway police, the Bihar Special Armed Police, the Prohibition Department and the State Narcotics Control Bureau, among other agencies. The Cabinet also approved a one-time remission measure for eligible convicted prisoners to facilitate their release from jails on the occasion of Mahatma Gandhi''s birth anniversary on October 2, 2026. It further approved amendments to Rule 743 of the Bihar Prison Manual, 2012, in accordance with the Supreme Court''s orders of July 30 and September 10, 2026, in the case concerning discrimination inside prisons. For the agriculture and livestock sector, the Cabinet approved the state scheme Mukhyamantri Gaudhan Vikas Rin Yojana for 2026-27 to 2028-29, involving an estimated expenditure of Rs 160.001 crore. The government also approved release of Rs 757.63 crore to Bihar State Power (Holding) Company Ltd in five equal instalments towards unfunded terminal benefit liabilities of former Bihar State Electricity Board employees up to October 31, 2012. Under Saat Nischay-3, the Cabinet approved a Rs 126.07-crore dairy development programme in Supaul, Madhepura and Saharsa districts. The programme includes setting up a curd plant, premium ice-cream plant, Total Mixed Ration plant, buffalo heifer farm, use of sex-sorted semen, formation of new dairy cooperative societies and installation of milk chilling infrastructure. A Rs 195.28-crore project under the Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF) was also approved for transforming the Siwan wetlands cluster in Basantpur, Bhagwanpur Hat and Goriakothi into an integrated aquaculture and export-oriented value chain.

national_raw_news.title: 4 hours ago | National 77 MY Bharat platform crosses 3 Crore registered youth since its launch in 2023
national_raw_news.content: MY Bharat platform has crossed more than three crore registered youth since its launch in the year 2023. The achievement reflects the ever expanding youth participation that takes part in learning, volunteering, leadership, civic engagement and youth-led initiatives. A platform to engage youth of the nation, MY Bharat runs under the Department of Youth Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. MY BHARAT is a national platform established by the Department of Youth Affairs to help you learn, lead, and serve so India can build Viksit Bharat by 2047 together. The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports said in a statement that the platform crossed more than 2 crore registrations in October last year. It also highlighted that the number subsequently expanded to more than 2.46 crore registered youth by August of this year. Today, the platform serves as a common digital gateway through which young people can discover and participate in Experiential Learning Programmes, volunteering opportunities, quizzes, leadership initiatives, youth dialogues and community engagement activities. The Ministry also highlighted that more than 1.22 lakh youth had enrolled in nearly 25,000 Experiential Learning Programmes, providing opportunities for young people to gain practical exposure through participation beyond conventional classroom settings till August this year.

national_raw_news.title: President Murmu, PM Modi congratulate Indian skeet teams on winning Asian Games bronze 8 hours ago 120
national_raw_news.content: President Droupadi Murmu has congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan on winning the Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games. President Murmu also extended wishes to Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan on securing a Bronze Medal in the Men’s Skeet Team. In a social media post, the President said that their skill, determination and team spirit have made the nation proud. President Murmu also extended her best wishes to them for achieving even greater success in the future. Prime Minister Narendra Modi today congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Maheshwari Chauhan, and Raiza Dhillon on winning the Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games held in Japan. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that their focus, precision and teamwork have brought another proud moment for Indian sports. He further extended his best wishes to them for their upcoming endeavours. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also congratulated Mirabai Chanu on winning a Silver medal in the Women’s 49 kilogram Weightlifting event. In a social media post, the Prime Minister stated that her determination and consistency continue to inspire the nation. He further extended his best wishes for Mirabai Chanu’s future endeavours. Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr Mansukh Mandaviya congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan on securing the first-ever Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games. Mr Mandaviya extended wishes to Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan on securing the Bronze Medal in the Men’s Skeet Team. He also congratulated Mirabai Chanu on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s 49kg Weightlifting event at the Asian Games and described it as a proud moment for the nation. In a social media post, Mr Mandaviya said this is Ms Chanu’s first Asian Games medal and stated that this brings India another medal at the Games after 28 years. He also congratulated Jay Meena on securing the first-ever Bronze Medal in the Men’s Singles Soft Tennis event at the Asian Games.

national_raw_news.title: India’s medal tally reaches eight at Asian Games as women’s skeet team wins bronze 14 hours ago 234
national_raw_news.content: At the Asian Games, the Indian trio of Maheshwari Singh, Parinaaz Dhaliwal and Raiza Dhillon secured the bronze medal in the women’s team skeet shooting event at Aichi-Nagoya, taking country’s overall medal tally on Day 4 to eight. In another feat, Jay Meena made history in soft tennis, assuring country its first-ever medal in the sport. Jay has advanced to the semifinals, defeating Sherwin Nuguit of the Philippines 4-3 in a closely fought quarterfinal. In shooting, Double Olympic medallist Manu Bhaker has qualified for the final of women’s 10-metre air pistol event. She finished third in the qualification round. However, the trio of Manu, Suruchi Singh and Esha Singh failed to qualify in the team event. Indian swimmer Beniston Benedicton has qualified for the final of the men’s 100-metre butterfly event. He finished ninth overall in the heats to secure his place in the final which will be held at 1:38 PM today. In rowing at the Asian Games, Balraj Panwar has qualified for the final of the men’s singles sculls event. He finished third in his heat with a timing of 6 minutes 52.84 seconds and was fourth overall across the two heats. The final will be held tomorrow. India have also secured final berth in the men’s double sculls event. Satnam Singh and Salman Khan finished second in their heat, clocking 6 minutes 15.63 seconds. They finished fourth overall across the two heats and advanced to the final. In canoeing, the Indian Men’s Kayak Four team has qualified for the Final A. The Indian team finished third in the heats, clocking 1 minute 29.447 seconds to secure a place in the final. In Sepaktakraw, Indian Men’s Regu team defeated Philippines, 2-0 in the opening Group B match, registering 15-7, 15-10 win. Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu will take part in the women’s 49-kilogram final. The match is scheduled to begin at 10 AM. She will be aiming for her first Asian Games medal after finishing fourth at the Hangzhou Games in 2023. India is already assured of medals in Men’s badminton and Women’s Wushu. The Men’s badminton team will take on China in the semi-final today, after defeating Japan in the quarter-final yesterday. The match is scheduled to begin at 11:30 AM. In Wushu, Roshibina Devi will face Indonesia’s Thania Kusumaningtyas in the women’s 60-kilogram Sanda semi-final at 2:50 PM. India’s skeet shooters Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan will be in action on the final day of qualification. In Hockey, the Indian Women’s Team will face Thailand in their third Pool B match this morning. The match will begin 11:30 AM. Indian Men’s and Women’s kabaddi teams will also continue their group-stage campaigns. Yesterday, the Indian women’s cricket team clinched country’s first gold medal of the Games, defeating Sri Lanka by 147 runs in the final. The victory took India’s medal tally to seven. In Boxing, Jadumani Singh advanced to the pre-quarterfinals in the Men’s 55-kilogram category, while Sakshi Chaudhary also progressed to the pre-quarterfinals. Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr Mansukh Mandaviya has congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan on securing the first-ever Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games. Mr Mandaviya also extended wishes to Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan on securing the Bronze Medal in the Men’s Skeet Team.

national_raw_news.title: Bihar’s cultural heritage showcased through 65 mementos in PM Mementos e-Auction 3 mins ago 1
national_raw_news.content: The cultural heritage and spiritual traditions of Bihar are being presented through 65 mementos in the PM Mementos e-Auction this year. The collection features Madhubani and Mithila paintings, Sikki and Manjusha art, traditional crafts, historical personalities and religious landmarks associated with the state. The Madhubani paintings depict themes including Ram-Sita Vivah, Ram Darbar, Chhath Puja and Das Mahavidya. The collection also includes Mithila Paags decorated with traditional motifs such as fish and lotus flowers. Sikki grass art is represented through several works, including a model of the new Parliament House. A Manjusha painting from Bhagalpur also depicts Bharat Mata against the map of India. It also features mementos depicting freedom fighter Mangal Pandey, Ashoka Stambh, Takhat Sri Harmandir Ji Patna Sahib, Lord Buddha and Mahavir Swami. Several temples and pilgrimage sites of Bihar are also represented, including Punaura Dham, Maa Aranya Devi Temple, Baba Garibnath Temple and Mundeshwari Devi Temple. The 8th edition of the PM Mementos e-Auction is underway online and will continue till the 2nd of next month. The Ministry of Culture said that the base price of the mementos range between 15 hundred to 1 lakh 20 thousand rupees. It added that the collection offers collectors an opportunity to engage with the state’s living traditions of art, craft, faith and history.

national_raw_news.title: Media delegation from Bhopal visits AIIMS Vijaypur, Bahu Fort Aquarium - Daily Excelsior
national_raw_news.content: Media delegation from Bhopal visits AIIMS Vijaypur, Bahu Fort Aquarium - Daily Excelsior Menu Todays story Latest News State Business National International Editorials Sunday Magazine State National Business Opinion Sports International Sunday Magazine J&K Govt Orders Videos Employment Prof (Dr) Sanjeev Sinha, Director & CEO, AIIMS Vijaypur, posing with visiting media delegation from Bhopal. Excelsior Correspondent JAMMU, Sept 23: A delegation of media persons from Bhopal, on an exposure tour organized by the Press Information Bureau (PIB), today visited AIIMS Vijaypur in Samba district, and the Aquarium-cum-Awareness Centre at Bahu Fort, Jammu, to gain first-hand insight into major infrastructure, healthcare, academic and developmental initiatives in the region. At AIIMS Vijaypur, the delegation interacted with senior faculty and officials and was briefed on the institute’s expanding clinical, academic and research activities. Prof (Dr) Sanjeev Sinha, Director & CEO, AIIMS Vijaypur, said the institute has a 750-bed capacity, including 650 fixed beds, modern modular operation theatres, a fully equipped emergency medicine block and an integrated AYUSH Centre. He said the hospital is witnessing a daily OPD footfall of 1,000 to 2,000 patients, averaging around 1,500, with patients arriving from Jammu & Kashmir, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh and even New Delhi. He said 30 broad specialties and 14 super-specialties, including Cardiology, Neurosurgery and Plastic Surgery, are operational, enabling comprehensive treatment locally. Prof (Dr) Shabab Lalit Angurana, Professor, Dean of Research, and HoD Radiotherapy & Oncology, said the institute, which started with 50 MBBS seats, is admitting 125 students in the current batch. It is also running MD programmes and 50 super-specialty seats, including M Ch in Pediatric Surgery and DM in Endocrinology, while PhD programmes are expected to commence soon. Prof (Dr) Vijay Kundal, Dr Amit Chaudhary, Assistant Professor, Department of Hospital Administration, and other senior administrative and clinical officers were present. Later, the delegation visited the Aquarium-cum-Awareness Centre at Bahu Fort, where Joint Director, Department of Fisheries, Masood Hussain, briefed them on sectoral initiatives. Spread over 30 kanals, the Rs 8.40-crore Phase-I facility houses the country’s largest freshwater aquarium with over 100 fish species and attracts visitors throughout the year. The delegation was informed that the ongoing Phase-II includes North India’s first and India’s third marine aquarium, scheduled to open in November, featuring a 4-lakh-litre marine water system, 50-mm acrylic glass with 98 per cent transparency and 18,000 kg of specialized salt.
